propertySets.name: Pset_FlowMeterTypeWaterMeter
propertySets.definition: Device that measures, indicates and sometimes records, the volume of water that passes through it without interrupting the flow.

properties.name: Type
properties.definition: Defines the allowed values for selection of the flow meter operation type.

properties.name: ConnectionSize
properties.definition:
The connection size of the object.

Inlet and outlet pipe connections to the meter.

properties.name: MaximumFlowRate
properties.definition: Maximum rate of flow which the meter is expected to pass.

properties.name: MaximumPressureLoss
properties.definition: Pressure loss expected across the meter under conditions of maximum flow.

properties.name: BackflowPreventerType
properties.definition: Identifies the type of backflow preventer installed to prevent the backflow of contaminated or polluted water from an irrigation/reticulation system to a potable water supply.
